hypothesis: Blind Quaternary geothermal fault conduits and unmapped range-front/piedmont fault strands in NW Nevada are jointly identifiable where shallow convective heat leakage (INGENIOUS 2-m temperature probe F2mDAB anomalies across 34 basins), relict/active hydrothermal vent precipitates (sinter, explosion craters, travertine, tufa, silicified fault breccia, thermal geothermometers), hydrothermal magnetite destruction + clay-cap/potassic alteration (negative shallow RTP residual x elevated electrical conductivity x low Th/K), exact Fourier upward-continued gravity/magnetic tilt migration + cross-strike hanging-wall step asymmetry, quantile-bridged 1m LiDAR + 10m 3DEP + bedrock chi knickpoints, and strictly visible-only elastic crack-tip / relay-ramp mechanics converge; furthermore, allocating binary predictions via exact Charnes-Cooper fractional-programming marginal E[DTI] optimization (coupling pixel fault posterior p_exact with calibrated 300-m kernel self-credit q_300m) recovers substantially higher true-positive kernel coverage along high-certainty traces while probing uncertain blind corridors sparsely without copying 37,654-dot uniform 2.8-px templates.
mechanism: 1) Construct 84 strictly leak-free physical, hydrothermal-vent, potential-field Fourier continuation, cross-strike block-step, and fold-isolated visible-network features on the exact 3730x3292 100-m grid (streaming into disk memmap, <750 MB peak RAM, explicitly blocking forbidden columns dist_known_fault_px/known_fault/label). 2) Pass every single feature alone through symmetric ROC AUC leakage canaries (<=0.90 required) on buffered whole-component holdout. 3) Fit a heterogeneous 2-stage out-of-fold ensemble (Stage 1: deep interaction LightGBM + variance-reduced Extra-Trees LightGBM + HistGradientBoosting; Stage 2: 2D multi-azimuth spatial trace continuity & lateral sharpness MLP + L2 calibration heads predicting both exact trace posterior p_exact(x) and expected 300-m triangular kernel credit q_300m(x)). 4) Allocate binary {0,1} predictions outside d_cat <= 2.0 px via lazy-greedy submodular marginal utility u(x|S) = Delta_E[TP](x|S) - lambda* * (1 - q_300m(x)), with lambda* calibrated strictly on inner training quadrants via Charnes-Cooper fixed-point optimization.
named_non_fault_mimic: Down-gradient lateral outflow plumes of thermal groundwater within permeable alluvial-fan paleochannels (displacing 2-m temperature anomalies laterally away from the source fault), non-tectonic primary volcanic cooling/flow margins with low remanent magnetization, and pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline bars across piedmont fans.
